reasons.body1: Yu dey see viewers dey give gift, wey dem dey send while yu dey live stream, wit tiered gift animations and tip messages dey read out loud for stream. Tips dey settle on-chain for DeHub tokens and land directly for yu wallet, no bi clip am for go.
reasons.body2: Yout followers no dey belong to pesin wey dey keep database. Streams and uploads fit dey mint for your wallet, feed dey follow chronological order, and code dey open source, so nobody fit quietly rewrite rules.
reasons.body3: Yu invite link pay yu 20% of everybodi wey join through am, plus 5% recurring from pipo dem wey dem go invite, pay for DeHub tokens.
reasons.body4: Host live audio Stages fo question, collab and watch party. Announce one before time with card weh your audience fit share, and listen back fo di one dem weh dem don record.
reasons.body5: De connect a yu odoh account wan time, go post a X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Farcaster, na eight more platform from DeHub composer. Keep TikTok as yu own discovery engine while yu build yu own audience.
reasons.body6: Bring whole YouTube channel, or TikTok, Vimeo or SoundCloud profile, all fo one batch. Dem go show you di exact price fo DeHub token before you pay.

proof.title: Wia dis number dem di kam from
proof.subtitle: Cloudflare di measure-am, no be dis page
proof.query: Di exact query weh dei bihain di chart
proof.edge: Eni request weh go dehub.io di pass fo Cloudflare bifo i rich wi server dem. Dis count dem na Cloudflare i own aggregation fo dat traffic — di sem figure dem weh wi dashboard di sho. Dem no di collect-am bai wan script fo yua browser, so notin fo dis page fit inflate-am, an if yu block tracker dem i no go chenj-am.
proof.live: Di page di read-am live. Wen /stats load, i di call wi endpoint, weh di query Cloudflare i Analytics API dat moment sef an cache di answer for 60 second dem.
proof.limits: Wetin dis di sho, an wetin i no di sho: yu fit si sei di figure dem di kam from Cloudflare i aggregation, no be from wi application code, an sei di query weh dem publish hia na di wan weh di run. I no be trustless — na wi di hold di API token, an Cloudflare no di ofa eni public read fo wan zone i analytics. Eni pesin weh get dem own Cloudflare zone fit run di sem query against-am an confam di shape.

definitions.title: Wetin di number dem min
definitions.visitors: — unique IP address dem weh Cloudflare si dat dei. I klos to pesin dem, bot i no sem exact: wan office weh dei fo wan connection, dem count-am wan taim, an wan phone weh di muv bitwin wifi an mobile data, dem count-am tuways.
definitions.pageViews: — request dem weh Cloudflare di classify lek page load dem, no be picture dem, script dem or API call dem.
definitions.bots: — dis dem na raw edge count dem, so crawler dem, uptime monitor dem an scripted client dem dei insaid. Yu fit si-am yuaself fo di browser breakdown weh dei op, wia entry dem lek “Curl” an “Unknown” na automated traffic, no be pesin dem. For filter bot dem komot, i nid wan paid Cloudflare tier weh wi no di run, an if wi kwaitli subtract wan estimate i go mek di number dem les checkable, no moa checkable.
definitions.total: — page view dem an request dem di add op across di range. Visitor count dem, dem no purposely sum-am go wan headline “total visitors”, bikos som pesin weh dei ya Monday an Tuesday go dem count-am tuways.
definitions.peakTerm: Awa / dei weh get plenti activity pas
definitions.peak: — di haiest unique count fo eni wan bucket fo di range, fo di sem reason: na wan figure weh Cloudflare actually di measure-am, no be wan weh dem build-am bai adding count dem weh overlap.
definitions.resolution: — na Cloudflare i limit fo dis plan, i no be choice: i di refuse eni hourly query weh pas tri dei. Di 24-awa an 3-dei view dem na hourly; 7 dei an moa na daily, an no wei dei for draw wan hourly chart for all-time.
definitions.breakdown: — dis dem di follow di range weh yu pick, bot na only bak {{max}} dei dem, weh na so far di per-dei breakdown dei kept. Fo longa range dem, di chart di kova moa taim pas wetin di country list di kova.
definitions.start: — “all time” min sei eni dei weh Cloudflare stil di keep-am, weh tudei na {{days}} dei weh start {{date}}, di dei weh dehub.io muv go Cloudflare. No earlier edge data dei for sho, an oda dei dem weh olda dem di komot wen Cloudflare don age dem out.
definitions.estimated: — since {{date}}, dehub.io dei pass for wan relay server so dat network dem weh no fit reach Cloudflare direct fit still load di site. So Cloudflare dei si most visitor dem as di relay i wan address, an i unique count fall plenty. Fo dat dei dem, di chart dei sho di page view dem weh we measure, multiply by di normal visitor-per-page-view ratio fo di {{days}} dei dem befo ({{ratio}}%). Page view dem an request dem still dei measure direct, an Cloudflare i count weh nobody touch dei fo di raw response weh we link fo up.

Your job be go spread da news wey DeHub dey talk about for every channel you dey touch — social media, meetup wey people dey go meet IRL, gaming event, campus wey university dey, and more. Na role wey you go earn salary every month, no commission. You go earn money wey dey consistent while you grow together wey platform.

depin.heroImageAlt: Wetin wey be a small computer box dat fit inside house, connect to people house, and studio for creator, make dey do fast calculation close to dem, no need send everything to big server far away.
depin.heroCaption: DeHub keep de original copy. Community node add strong copy (replica) and local delivery power.
depin.earlyAccessBody: Lightweight, browser-based node dey open down below. Heavy, always-on desktop node dey talk about for future, but no dey come yet. Participation no guarantee reward.

depin.threeJobsBody: Operators dey choose own storage, bandwidth, na compute limit. DeHub dey schedule only work dat machine dey safe handle.
depin.transcodeBody: Mashin wey fit na dem wey upload video naa, turn dem naa video wey adaptable. Every output wey come out, check dem first before dem go serve.

depin.availableReplicasBody: Seri wey a go dey close na segment wey a be verify, close na wey a go dey fit demand

depin.privacyBody: Media wey go protect, still stay encrypt on computer wey community use. Key wey go play, go give separate fi person wey go watch, na person wey go get authorise.
depin.publicContentBody: Enkripshon no stop casual inspection of cache file, but public media still dey watchable through public DeHub player. We no go claim different.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Operators naam disk limit, bandwidth limit, workin hour, naa eligible public content categories. Removal notice dem trigger cache clear.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Wok yu na usefu, na reward na still move-move. No fix.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Verified bytes wey go dey play real time for session.
depin.revenuePoolBody: Naa, if wey wey activate, budget for reward go dey come from revenue wey platform get after epoch finish.
depin.noFixedRate: No get fixed rate, minimum return, APY or forward estimate. Contribution record na only for accounting, no be promise of payment. Any future token settlement go happen for Base and remain subject to eligibility, network rule and applicable law.
depin.runningCosts: Run a node sey use electricity, data internet, na hardware life. Operator no get nafa, na cost wey dem dey exceed any reward wey dem get.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: DePin na go add extra path fo delivery wey DeHub na dey use first. After wey dem confirm verification dey strong, dem go dey send heavy workloads.
depin.deliveryBody: Peer-to-peer live and video streaming, automatic switch to backup if connection weak.
depin.faqOfflineA: Na coordinator remove e go from active route. Another replica take care of e segment, or playback fall back to DeHub origin storage while replacement copies dey schedule.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Node operator fit see di content we dem host?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Content wey go protect, dey store as encrypted segments, na host no dey get playback key. Content wey go public, still dey visible for everybody through DeHub, na design wey so.
depin.faqHowMuchA: Wetin no dey fixed rate or forekast. Contribution wey confirm, dem go get share wey come from reward pool wey dey fund by revenue, after epoch finish. Reward no guarantee, na. Cost wey come from electricity, bandwidth, and hardware, dem go be more dan reward wey dey.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: Lightweight browser-based node wey dey now: sign in and choose yes on dis page, and your open tab go dey like a node while you keep it open. Heavy, always-on desktop node wey dey as future plan — no dey exist yet.
depin.faqInstallNeededA: No. E go run wey wey inside tab, use browser local storage. Close tab, node wey wey stop. No background service, no install.

glossary.deltaDesc: Dey green or red arrow wey fit na side a eni entry a leaderboard, dem show how much balance a user get wey dey change for time period wey dem select (1 day, 1 week, etc.).
glossary.dmDesc: Mesaji pribat wey dey available for mobile app, web go dey come soon.
glossary.downvoteDesc: Vot against goment proposal or fetish request. Help signal komuniti opozishun.
glossary.engagementStatsDesc: The Post Info page de show total like, dislike, view, comment, and dash wey the post don get — e de give you full picture of how the post de perform.
glossary.followersDesc: Yu go follow pipo wey dey post, na dem go dey show for yu profile.
glossary.fractionMarketplaceDesc: Market tab wey dey Post Info paje, wey fraction holders fit list dema fractions for sale and buyers fit make offer. Dis one dey make trading of content ownership possible.
glossary.homeFeedDesc: Wetin you see fit be post from people you follow na trending content wey dey show for you.
glossary.imagePostDesc: Post wey get one or plenti image. Dem de store image for blockchain as NFT wit unique Token ID.
glossary.liveStreamDesc: Broadcast wey de happen for real time. People wey de watch fit comment and dash the person wey de stream. Stream de use low-latency HLS technology.
glossary.makeOfferDesc: M chapa 1/4 post fo post fo Facebook, na 5000 naira. M chapa 1/2 post fo 8000 naira, 3/4 post fo 12000 naira, na full post fo 15000 naira.
glossary.mentionDesc: Yu go tag anoda pesin wey dey for dia post or koment, yu go type @ followed by dia username. Dia go receive notis.
glossary.moreOptionsDesc: Open additional action like edit, delete, or report post.
glossary.notificationsDesc: Alerts for laik, komment, tip, folo, and anoda aktiviti wey dey relate to your akount.
glossary.postInfoPageDesc: Detailed view of any post wey de show im on-chain data, how people de interact wit am, ownership fraction, and creator info. You fit see am if you tap the "ⓘ" icon for any post.
glossary.ppvPurchasesDesc: For pay-per-view post, show wey number of user dey buy access, and total money creator dey earn.
glossary.privateDesc: Content wey only you fit see. Private post de hide from oda people and from the public feed.
glossary.publicDesc: Content wey everybody fit see. Anybody fit watch, like, and comment for public post.
glossary.reportDesc: Flag inappropriate or harmfull content for review. Report help keep komuniti safe.
glossary.shareDesc: Share post externally via link, or copy post URL to clipboard to send to odas.
glossary.showOriginalDesc: Afua translat, tap dis to revert back to original language of content.
glossary.storyDesc: Short video wey de comot afta 24 hour. Tap the ring for person im avatar for home feed to watch im story.
glossary.subscriberOnlyDesc: Content wey only people wey don subscribe to the creator im channel fit see.
glossary.swapDesc: Excheyn wan tokn for anoda direkt insaid app. Swaps hapen on-chain usin dezentralizd excheynz.
glossary.thumbsDownDesc: Wen yu dislike or disagree wit post. Dis feedback help improve content recommendation.
glossary.thumbsUpDesc: Wen yu like or agree wit post. Increase post engagement score and help am rank high in feed.
glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.translateButtonDesc: Translat post text, bio, and koment into yu prefer language. App auto-detect yu browser language or yu set one manuali in Setting.
glossary.txHashDesc: Transaksion ID. Klik am view full transaksion details for blockchain explorer.
glossary.txHashInfoDesc: The blockchain transaction hash from the time wey dem mint the post. Click am to open the block explorer (BaseScan or BscScan) and check the on-chain record.
glossary.unlistedDesc: Visibility setting wia the post no go show for feed or search, but anybody wey get the direct link fit still see am.
glossary.upvoteDesc: Vote fo’ support a governance proposal or feature request. Den help show dat community dey support.
glossary.videoPostDesc: Post wey get video. You fit set video make e bi public, private, or pay-per-view (PPV).
glossary.viewOnExplorerDesc: Yon open blockchain explorer (BaseScan) fi view transaction details for post or transfer.
glossary.visibilityControlDesc: Post owner fit change how people de see im post, whether Public (anybody fit see), Unlisted (only via direct link), or Private (only you). You fit do am from the Post Info page.
glossary.fractionsDesc: Post weh dem mint for DeHub go turn NFT weh dem divide for 1,000 fraction, and the creator go start with all 1,000 — 100% ownership for the content. Minting na your choice, and e fit happen when you di publish or later.
glossary.ownershipBarDesc: Progress bar for Post Info page weh di show how many of the 1,000 fraction the creator still hold and how many done share or sell.
glossary.tokenIdDesc: One special on-chain ID weh post di get when dem mint am as NFT for blockchain. Minting na your choice, so post weh dem never mint no get Token ID yet.
glossary.tokenIdInfoDesc: The special on-chain ID weh post di get once dem don mint am as NFT. E di show for top of Post Info page for post dem weh dem don mint.
glossary.tipDesc: Senda DeHub tokns direkti to a kontent kreator as a rewod for dia kontent. Tipes dey rekord on-chain.
glossary.totalTipsDesc: Show wey total amoun o post earn as tip from viewer, display for wey Post Info page.
glossary.listFractionsDesc: Ef you own small part of post, you can put dem for sell at price you choose (in token per small part). Other people can buy dem small part you put for sell.
glossary.walletDesc: Yu wallet wey dey hold yu DeHub tokens anodda kripto asets. Connected via Web3Auth for easy access.
glossary.stakingDesc: Yu lock ya DeHub tokens, yu go earn reward dey time go come. Tokens wey dey stake also give yu increase power to vote for governance.
glossary.stakingBadgeDesc: Badges wey show next to your name wey dey base on your total DeHub token dey keep (wallet + wey you stake). Dem have 13 level—more token you keep, higher your badge level go. Level high dey give you more power to vote for governance and lower platform fee. Level dey price in dollar, so number of token each level cost go down when token price rise—an once you earn a level, you keep it as long as you keep what cost you, no matter what price do after dat.

raffle.faqPurchaseAnswer: No. Every draw get at least one free way to enter, wey you fit get by taking part on DeHub. Some draws dey sell ticket wey you go pay with DeHub tokens, but ticket no be the only way to enter.
raffle.noPurchase: No money dey need. Every draw get one free way to enter, and if dem give ticket, dat one no be di only way to enter.

badgeLadder.intro: Each tier cost one fixed amount for dollars. The token figure wey dey beside am na wetin dat one cost for $0.001 reference price — di app dey ask for dat figure scaled to di live price, and never for more than am, so one falling price no fit raise di bar or take back one tier wey you don already earn.

postingAllowance.footnote: Badge tier na your DeHub tokens wey you hold plus wey you stake for BNB Chain and Base — e be the same balance wey your badge dey come from. The ladder get price for dollars, so the token figures wey dey above na wetin each tier cost for the $0.001 sale price and the requirement dey fall as the token price dey rise; a tier wey you don already earn, dem no go ever take am back because of the price. A badge wey your patron lend you dey show for your profile but e no dey increase your posting allowance — that one dey come from wetin you hold yourself. Allowances reset at 00:00 UTC, and a gigabyte here na 1,024 MB.

getting-started.title: Getting Started
getting-started.intro: DeHub get five way enta, no one of dem need you buy wallet: Google, Apple, code wey dey send for your email, code wey dey send for your SMS, or wallet wey you connect already. Everyting except wallet way create non-custodial wallet for you for background - you hold key, DeHub pay gas so you fit post, tip and collect without buy native token.

steps.2: Klik 'Sign In'. Yu go see Google na Apple, filds for emai adres or fon nomber, na 'Connect Wallet' for existin wan.
steps.3: Wen yu use Google or Apple, komplait provider's flow. Wen yu use email or SMS, enta kod wey arrive.
steps.4: Wallet bi create an secure fo yin on first sign-in. Connectin yin own wallet bi mean one signat to prove address.
steps.6: Yu dey enter. Explore feed, set up profail, naa start post.

tips.2: Yu dey come back to yor ol' DeHub account? Sign in wit yor email or phone number wey dey use before, migration go find am for yor.
tips.3: Yu fit keep several account for one device an' switch between dem for Settings → Profile.

home-feed.title: Home Feed
home-feed.intro: Feed ya dey where yu see post from pipo wey yu dey follow an trendin kontent. E support multiple kontent-type tab an sorting opshon.

steps.1: Go near /app – dis be your home feed.
steps.2: Yu go select tab wey you want, na so you go see content wey dey inside am.
steps.3: Swip lef/right ya, si tabz ya dey show ya more opshonz for mobail.
steps.4: Wen yu wok wit feed, yu go fit chenj sorting usin filter/sort button wey dey top-right of feed.
steps.7: Kam gud, yu fit chenj layout wey yu dey use, yu fit chenj to Grid or Feed view paa.

tips.1: Grid view bi gud for browse image quick.
tips.2: Tab 'Home' dey show all tins wey dey mixed together.
tips.3: Live tab shows currently active live streams.

creating-posts.title: Creating Posts
creating-posts.intro: Post, share pikin, voice notis, GIFs, an' more. Use #hashtag, cashtag, an' mention to increase reach.

steps.1: Klik post buton wey dey sidebar (desktop) or + buton (mobile).
steps.2: Na me dey wait for wetin you go write.
steps.3: Yu go click icon of media na select file.
steps.4: Tiketa voice note, klick microphone icon.
steps.5: Kam giff, klick GIF icon na search for one.
steps.6: I no understand wetin you dey talk.
steps.7: $cashtags no dey make sense for me.
steps.9: Klik 'Post' to publish. Ya post dey appear for feed immediately.

tips.1: Posts support markdown-style formatting.
tips.2: Yuu go post again by klick am repost icon for post na select 'Quote'.

interacting-with-posts.intro: Vot yong content, koment, tip, bukmark, shar, na translat.

steps.1: Voting post: upvote or downvote post wia arrow icon wey dey left side of post.
steps.2: Klik comment icon na open comment section, na leave reply.
steps.3: Klik na gem/tip ikon, sendim tip in DeHub tokens to post kreator.
steps.4: Klikim buk marka save post for later.
steps.6: Klik an na button ya translate (globe) wia post ya, na translate text to your language.
steps.7: Yu go use 'Translate Image' buton, taim get AI-translated version of text for image.

tips.3: Bukumkum post dem dey accessible from Bookmarks paja for sidebar.

steps.1: Go find am for sidebar, navigate to /app/explore.
steps.2: Use di search bar for top go search for pipo, post, or tin wey you dey find.
steps.3: Yooki yooki, filter result bi tab: All, Pipo, Pọt, Piks, Vidiyo, Musik, Liva.
steps.4: Browse trendin topik an categories for explore paji.
steps.5: Klik insis on topik wey dey trend to see all post wey relate.
steps.6: Klik paa wuman bi search result to visit dia profail.

tips.1: Yanga search support pesin wey dey use username, wallet address, and keyword for search.
tips.2: Trending topik update bas on recent post wey dey happen.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: Yout profail showkam yout póst, folozer, foloing, an wallet inforamayshun.

steps.1: Klik yor poto ya yu or 'Profile' for view yu profile.
steps.3: Uploa picha ya profail yu by klikin on yu avata in edit moda.
steps.4: Yu go check ya follower and followin count for ya profail page.
steps.5: Browse yor own post, media, and like content via di profile tab.
steps.6: Kopi wallet address yu, klick icon wey dey beside am.
steps.7: Go visit pipo profile by click dia username or dia poto anywhere for platform.

tips.1: Yu be unique, na yu name dey show for yu profile URL (dehub.io/@username).
tips.2: Yu go fit control who go see ya follower count.

messages.title: Messages
messages.intro: Senda mesaji direkt to oda pesin we dey for platform.

steps.1: Klik 'Messages' for inbox open.
steps.2: Klik di kompos button to start new konversayshun.
steps.3: Sori, no be say you go find user by username, but you fit search am.
steps.4: Wen yu type yor mesaji, yu press send.
steps.5: Wetin yu see fit for chat history fit for message list.
steps.6: Klik fit for one chat fit for continue chat.

tips.1: Yu go get notification fit for someone message yu.
tips.2: Creator go lock message fit for tip requirement.

ai-assistant.title: AI Assistant
ai-assistant.intro: Chat fit for DeHub AI assistant fit for help, info, and creative work.

steps.1: Klik 'Assistant' fit for sidebar fit for open AI chat.
steps.2: Type yu question or request fit for chat input.
steps.3: AI go help fit for crypto info, platform question, and general knowledge.
steps.4: Start new chat fit for klik new chat button.
steps.5: See yu chat history fit for sidebar fit for assistant page.
steps.6: Yu go attach image fit for AI fit for analyze.

tips.1: AI remember context fit for conversation.
tips.2: Yu go ask AI fit for DeHub feature, crypto term, or general question.
tips.3: Previous chat save and accessible anytime.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Stay update fit for like, comment, tip, follow, and other activity fit for yu content.

steps.1: Klik bell icon or 'Notifications' fit for sidebar.
steps.2: See all notification fit for chronological list.
steps.3: Klik fit for notification fit for go fit for related content.
steps.4: Notification include: new follower, post vote, comment, tip, and mention.
steps.5: Unread notification highlight — dem mark as read fit for view.

tips.1: Notification badge show count fit for unread notification.
tips.2: Tip notification show how many token yu receive.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.intro: See yu DeHub token balance fit for multiple chain, check stake deposit, and manage yu asset.

steps.1: Klik 'Wallet' fit for sidebar fit for open wallet page.
steps.2: See yu total token balance aggregate fit for all support chain.
steps.3: See breakdown fit for chain: Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, and more.
steps.4: Check yu stake deposit and reward.
steps.5: Klik 'Refresh Scan' fit for update yu balance fit for on-chain data.
steps.6: Copy yu wallet address fit for receive token fit for other people.

tips.1: Balance update automatic but yu go force refresh anytime.
tips.2: D wallet show both liquid (available) and stake balance.

staking.title: Staking
staking.intro: Stake yo DeHub token fo earn reward and increase yo governance vote power.

steps.1: Go to 'Staking' page from sidebar.
steps.2: Enter number of token you wan stake.
steps.3: Select chain you wan stake on.
steps.4: Confirm transaction in yo wallet (external wallet) or auto-execute (social login).
steps.5: See yo stake amount and any pending reward.
steps.6: Fo unstake, enter amount and confirm unstake transaction.

tips.1: Staking increase yo vote weight in governance proposal.
tips.2: Social-login user no need gas fo stake — gasless.
tips.3: You can stake on multiple chain at once.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.intro: See who top! Leaderboard rank user by balance, daily spend, and trending topic.

steps.1: Go to 'Leaderboard' page from sidebar.
steps.2: Switch between tab: Balance, Daily Spent, and Talk of the Town.
steps.3: Balance tab ranks users by their total token holdings.
steps.4: Daily Spent tab show who most active tip in last 24 hour.
steps.5: Talk of the Town show most-discuss topic/category.
steps.6: Click any user fo visit profile.

tips.1: Daily rankings reset every 24 hours.
tips.2: Talk of the Town track single-word category from hashtag.

command-centre.title: Command Centre
command-centre.intro: Dashboard overview show yo key metric and platform activity at glance.

steps.1: Click 'Command Centre' in sidebar.
steps.2: See yo profile summary, include post count, follower, and engagement.
steps.3: See yo recent activity and trending topic.
steps.4: Access quick link fo commonly use feature.

tips.1: Command Centre give yo bird-eye view of yo DeHub presence.

governance.title: Governance
governance.intro: Participate in platform governance by create proposal and vote on community decision.

steps.5: Wetin you go do be wey wey, leave comments on proposals so we can talk about dem wit community.
steps.1: Go to 'Governance' from sidebar.
steps.2: Browse active proposal submit by community.
steps.3: Click proposal fo read full description and discussion.
steps.4: Vote on proposal use thumbs up/down button — yo vote weight depend how many DeHub token you stake.
steps.6: Wen yu wok wan submit yor own propoz, yu go klick di 'Kree8 Propoz' buton.

tips.1: Yu voting powa dey depend on di number of tokens yu stake.
tips.2: Badge holders may get additional vote weight.
tips.3: Proposals go through stages: Active → Passed/Rejected.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.intro: Save post fo yor bookmark fo easy access later.

steps.1: Klik di bookmark icon for save post.
steps.2: Go find "Bookmarks" for side bar, see all save post.
steps.3: Klik an na bookmark post yu wok view am full.
steps.4: Kam deya, kip klick di bookmark icon anod remove di bookmark.

tips.1: Bukmark dey private — only you sabi wetin you save.
tips.2: No limit to how many post you fit book mark.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Yook customize yor DeHub experience wit language, privacy, na display preference.

steps.1: Klik 'Settings' insida sidebar.
steps.2: M chenge display laengen from selektan laengen.
steps.3: Adjust priwansi: Kontrolla who dey see your folo count na who you dey folo.
steps.4: Mi go set mi post visibility preference to Public.
steps.5: Manage notification preferences.

tips.1: DeHub support multiple langwaj, de whole interface dey translate.
tips.2: Privacy settings apply immediately.

steps.1: Post as normal. Wia allowance, no tins dey charge yu, no tins dey ask yu.
steps.2: Tek posts na media separate, so day yu dey upload video, all ten tek posts still free.
steps.3: Wen post go pass, app price am first, den check wallet whether you get money dey cover am before upload.
steps.4: Post go publish exactly like dat - publish no dey wait for payment.
steps.5: Yon dey approve wan transfer for dat post only, settle on wetin dey hold enough DeHub tokens for Base or BNB Chain.

tips.1: Oversize dey dey calculate pro-rata: 200 MB pass yor allowance go cost 200 MB, no be whole gigabyte.
tips.2: Reposts, comments, reactions, tips na messages no dey cost naira, dem no dey touch allowance.
tips.3: Yu no go collect payment, post go remain up — amount go block yu next paid post until yu settle am. Tomorrow free allowance dey always belong to yu.
tips.4: A stakin badge ris raise free allowance na lower price of anytin wey pass am.

reactions-and-safety.title: Reactions, Muting & Mature Content
reactions-and-safety.intro: Dem nine reaksishon dey for behin like button, na set of kontrols wey dey help yu decide wetin yu go see and who go fit reach yu.

steps.2: Di seven pipo we dey like, dem count towards di post like total; dislike and poo count against am.
steps.5: Kreator dem mark dia own post wey dey mature while dem dey kompose am; post wey dem mark dis way no go appear for public home feed.
steps.6: Na ya, turn on "Show mature content" for Settings.

tips.1: Post wey dey mature, still dey visible for creator account and to pipo wey dey follow am.
tips.2: Blak blokin from pipo profile go beyond mute, na even block pesin from send yim messaji.
tips.3: Di reaksiyon tray dey show who reakt and wetin dem reakt wit, so yu no dey see just number, yu dey see di room.

stages.title: Stages (Live Audio Rooms)
stages.intro: Stages bi audio room wey dey build inside DeHub. Host open room, bring speaker up, an anyone fit join listen from Stages paje or shared link.

steps.2: Tap live stage join listener, or set reminder on schedule one, get told wen e start.
steps.4: Mi go bring speaker-dem on stage, mute dem or remove dem, share screen, na soundboard go drive am.
steps.5: Pipo dey send live reactions and dey chat for room, but dem no dey come on stage.
steps.6: E ben stage record, na recording dey play back afta from card am dey sit.

tips.4: Mini-player dey keep room go, while yu browse rest of app.

communities.title: Communities & Events
communities.intro: Kampani dem dey run by memba, wit dia own feed, memba, na aktivity. Evens add taim-bound progreming on top of dem.

steps.1: Kam gud, go open 'Communities' for sidbarr na browse public ones.
steps.2: Kam join one tap. Nya activity dey show as unread badge for navigation.
steps.3: Post, diskut, run poll na tip insid komuniti own feed.
steps.4: Kampanyun dem dey moderate dia own kampani na dem fit grant admin right to odas.
steps.5: Open 'Event' for schedule progam wey you fit follow along wit live, one paja per event.

tips.1: Kam chat kam support @mention na @here, so post fit reach room.
tips.2: Invite link yɛ na yɛ bɛ kɛ community.

bounties-stores.title: Bounties & Stores
bounties-stores.intro: Yu go fit turn platform ya into income for yu: post or claim bounty, or open shop na sell to pipo wey dey follow yu.

steps.1: Buka 'Bounties' na browse open wok, filter by kategory or kurensi.
steps.2: Klaaim wan, go do am, na reward go dey wait am - anybodi fit be hunter, no need apply.
steps.3: Mun ya post ya bounti ya wona, na brief na reward ya DeHub token or USDC. Ya go into escrow moment ya post am.
steps.4: Kam paa 'Stores' set up stôr ai paa paja, wia e dey wok, na branding na listings.
steps.5: Product dey dey price an settle for DeHub tokens for wallet wey dey build-in, witout external checkout.

tips.1: Bounties dey organize for Social Media, Clipping na Contracts.
tips.2: Dispute flow settle di disagreement wey dey come from delivery, so escrow always resolve fairly.
tips.3: Kreator dem use bounties to grow community - shares, klips an reaksyon dey all valid task.

creator-studio.title: Creator Studio & Editor
creator-studio.intro: Kreator Studio yonge images, video, musik, voice na 3D model from prompt, na hand dem to edito - including a full multi-track video edito wey run for browser.

steps.1: Mi go open Creator Studio, na me go dey create somtin new. Me want make video, but no be just any video, me want make video wey go dey interesting, wey go dey capture di attention of pipo. Me want make video wey go dey show di beauty of Cameroon, di culture, di people, di food, di music, di dance, di everything! Me want make video wey go dey make pipo feel like dem dey Cameroon, like dem dey feel di vibe, di energy, di passion of di people.
steps.2: Server go tell you price before e do job, so you know wetin you go pay before you pay am.
steps.3: Renders dey continue for one shared queue while yu dey browse app.
steps.5: I no understand wetin you dey talk.

tips.1: Librai bilong free stok aset libri sit long side Studio, na emi dey for eni tins yu no wan genereit.

steps.1: Go sidon sideway, find "Buy" paja, click am.
steps.2: Swap tokn yu wok want.
steps.3: Wen yu wok, enta di amount yu wan spend or di numba of tokens yu wan get.
steps.4: Na exchange rate na 1 USD dey sell for 570 CFA. Estimated output go be 1,140,000 CFA.
steps.5: Klik settings gear ikon to adjust slippage tolerance (defaut na 1%).
steps.6: Kam gud, transaction swap don confirm.
steps.7: DeHub tokens go dey for ya wallet wen transaction complete.

tips.1: Slippaji ya up na, e dey increase chance of execute, but possibility of price bad dey high.
tips.2: Biko, check exchange rate beforu yu confirm.
tips.3: Yu fit set custom slippage for settings panel.

music-tv.title: Music & TV
music-tv.intro: Yen enjoy media kontent direkti for DeHub — stream musik and watch laif TV chanels.

steps.1: Go find 'Music' for sidebar, browse and play music post.
steps.2: Go near TV, see live TV channels.
steps.3: Browse chanel by kat or kontri.
steps.4: Klik an wan channel to start watch.
steps.5: Yu use player kontrollz adjust volume na playback.

tips.1: TV chanels dey get veri-dem for reliabiliti.
tips.2: Muzik post dey fit pley wile yu dey browse anoda kontent.

post-info.title: Post Info & Fractions
post-info.intro: Post wey dey minted na NFT wey dey split into 1,000 pieces. Post Info page show data wey dey on-chain, stat wey dey show how people dey engage, how ownership dey break down, and make you fit trade pieces of any post — on post wey no dey minted, e go offer you to mint instead.

steps.1: Tap am 'ⓘ' icon for post, open Post Info paja.
steps.2: Yu go see Token ID (unique on-chain identifier) an transaction hash — click hash to view am for block explorer.
steps.3: Bia, statis bileng na pipo don dey engage, na im dey show total laik, dislike, view, koment, na tipe dem don receive.
steps.5: If di post na pay-per-view (PPV), yu go see price, kuri, and how many pipo don buy access.
steps.6: Pipo wey dey own post, dem fit change visibility (Public, Unlisted, or Private) and edit titl/describ straight from dis page.

tips.1: A newly minted post start wit di creator hold all 1,000 fractions (100% ownership).
tips.2: Transaksion hash link to BaseScan or BscScan depend on chain.
tips.3: Post wey no dey list, no go dey appear for feeds but still dey accessible via direct link.

buying-fractions.title: Buying Fractions
buying-fractions.intro: Wetin you go buy fraction of any post fo get share wey dem content dey. Fraction trading dey happen inside marketplace tab wey dey inside Post Info page.

steps.1: Open de Post Info page fo de post you like (tap de 'ⓘ' icon).
steps.2: Go to 'Marketplace' tab wey dey for see nawaa listin' an' offer wey dey available.
steps.5: En a number of fraction you wan go enter, na price per fraction go put in DeHub token.
steps.6: Confirm yu offer — na di fraction holder go accept or reject im.
steps.7: Wen yu accept, na fraction go transfer wey yu wallet, na token go send wey seller.

tips.1: Check de holders list fo see de current ownership distribution befoe you buy.
tips.2: Yu dey hold pawa of dat on-chain NFT.
tips.3: Frakshun price wey seller set — go shop around fo best deal.

selling-fractions.title: Selling Fractions
selling-fractions.intro: E fi you own small small part of post (like creator or buy), you can sell dem on marketplace.

steps.4: Enter wey number a fraction you wan sell.
steps.6: Check wey total price fit for listin, confirm for me, oh!
steps.7: Youse fractions now fit wey dey show — odah people can buy dem or make counter-offer.

tips.1: Wetin you go list any amount up to your total balance wey you dey keep in fraction.
tips.3: Manga creator, bi sell pawa fraishon, make fan dey own pawa wey dey content.

minting-posts.title: Minting Posts (Creating NFTs)
minting-posts.intro: Minting na optional. Post publish of-chain, taim yu send am - no wallet, no sign, no gas - na yu go mint am as NFT, wen yu dey compose am or later from post itself.

steps.1: Klik post buton wey dey sidebar (desktop) or + buton (mobile).
steps.4: Publishing no wait am for chain: post go publish for feed, whether you like am or no.
steps.5: Tin mint later, opn post 'ⓘ' info paja na use Mint aktion dey.
steps.6: Wen mint, post get Token ID na transaction hash yu fit verify on-chain, na yu hold all 1,000 fraishun of am.

tips.3: Minting na wetin make post dey fit trade and dey bring royalty. Post wey no dey mint still go get tips and views.
tips.4: Record ya on-chain permanent, even if post ya dey delete from feed.

steps.1: Glossari go dey for sidebar, go navigate.
